about_the_game:
Nature is in danger!
A mysterious toxic smoke rises from underground, corrupting nature and turning the island’s creatures into hostile, aggressive beings.

Defend your village and protect your new home by battling corrupted creatures, exploring the island, and venturing into the deep underground labyrinths. Uncover the origin of the poisonous fumes and put an end to the threat endangering the entire island!

Get ready for an adventure filled with action, mystery, and exploration!

  • Open-World Exploration: Traverse forests, beaches, and caves as you search every corner of the island. Discover ancient temples, mysterious caves, and landscapes twisted by corruption.

  • Dynamic Combat: Face corrupted creatures with a fluid and responsive action-combat system.

  • Choices & Consequences: Every decision will influence the island’s fate and your own future.

  • Upgrades & Abilities: Fight, gain experience and level up, becoming increasingly stronger. Find ancient artifacts, new weapons, and develop new abilities to fight the growing evil.

  • Meet Unique Characters

    Interact with a diverse cast, each with their own backstory and personality, enhancing your gameplay with rich and memorable encounters.

  • A Stunning 2D Pixel Art World

    Immerse yourself in beautifully crafted pixel art that brings the game’s natural environments to life. Each scenario is teeming with unique creatures and slimes, making every area a delight to explore.

  • Side Quests and Minigames

    From charming cats to engaging minigames, a variety of side quests offer hours of entertainment and diverse gameplay to keep you captivated.

short_description: Big Boy Adventure is an Action-Adventure RPG game. Embark on an epic journey starting from a small island, explore mysterious anomalies on the island and battle creatures that exhibit increasingly unusual behavior. Assist villagers by completing their requests.
